messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - Canary EU-1 reporting elevated 5xx rate (5m window). service=inference-api, split=12%, error_rate=3.4% -> paging oncall. dashboard: https://redwood.cloud/d/dash/inference-eu-1
emma (oncall): on it. paging shawn and priya. do we have customer-facing impact?
maria (customer-success): seeing a handful of customer error reports for chat completions in EU. low volume but some key accounts hit.
shawn (sre): pulling logs now. looks like model backend 503s from ortho-proxy. rolling logs:
shawn (sre): ```
2026-03-17T13:02:12Z inference-api eu-1 proxy: upstream timeout for model-worker-7
2026-03-17T13:03:01Z inference-api eu-1 proxy: connection reset by peer - model-worker-3
```
priya (eng): this started right after the canary image v4.1.0 was promoted to 12% traffic. suspect regression in worker pooling.
lee (deploy): we can either snip the canary (set split=0) or rollback. which do we prefer for fastest mitigation?
emma (oncall): snip to 0% first to stop exposure. if errors persist on prev version we rollback. execute snip and smoke checks.
lee (deploy): running rw-deploy traffic adjust --service inference-api --region eu-1 --split 0 --from canary-1747 -> now (cmd id: c7f2)
incident-bot: Action logged: traffic split change requested by lee. (c7f2)
lee (deploy): traffic snip applied. canary split now 0%. monitoring metrics...
shawn (sre): error rate dropping in the last 30s. 5xx now 0.6% (was 3.4%).
maria (customer-success): forward PSAT to affected accounts: @account-eng-team started outreach.
priya (eng): we should still collect heap/perf dumps from canary pods for postmortem. grabbing core logs from canary-1747 instances.
lee (deploy): creating hotfix branch with revert of the canary change (if needed) and preparing rollback playbook: `rw-deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-revision v4.0.9 --region eu-1`
emma (oncall): run smoke test on production traffic mirror before full rollback. examples: 3 quick prompts, check latency and 200s.
priya (eng): smoke proxy checks: ```
- prompt1 -> 200, latency 120ms
- prompt2 -> 200, latency 110ms
- prompt3 -> 200, latency 130ms
```
shawn (sre): can confirm latency ok and 200s for mirrored smoke. errors remain only on archived canary pods (we captured cores). looks like worker-thread exhaustion under some concurrency pattern.
emma (oncall): OK - mitigation succeeded (snip). leaving canary offline for investigation. keeping this thread open until rollback decision is made and communication sent.
lee (deploy): posting rollback runbook to ops channel and scheduling coordinated rollback if QA confirms revert. ops runbook link: https://redwood.cloud/runbooks/rollback-inference-api
priya (eng): started bisect on the canary diff. I suspect the threadpool config introduced in v4.1.0. will raise PR with safe revert if confirmed.
maria (customer-success): setting customer status: low impact, transient. will update customers with timeline and next steps.
emma (oncall): tagging for postmortem: priya, shawn, lee, maria. follow-up meeting 30m. after-action checklist: logs archived, cores uploaded, canary artifacts quarantined.
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (canary traffic removed). severity: P1 -> P2. ticket: INC-2026-1734 created.
shawn (sre): archiving metrics and screenshots for postmortem (saved to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1767777000/).
priya (eng): creating revert PR now: PR #4821 with revert of threadpool patch. CI running.
lee (deploy): I'll stand by to coordinate rollback if PR approved.
emma (oncall): if PR merges, perform canary deploy of revert to 5% for 10m then ramp. Confirming closure criteria: traffic stable, 5xx < 0.5% for 10m, smoke tests green, a subset of affected accounts verified.
maria (customer-success): sending customer note: "We've removed the canary that caused errors and are investigating. No further action required from you at this time."
priya (eng): CI green, PR #4821 merged. ready for canary revert deploy.
lee (deploy): deploying revert canary: `rw-deploy promote --service inference-api --image inference-api:v4.0.9 --region eu-1 --split 5` (deploy id d9b3)
incident-bot: Deploy event: d9b3 started. will monitor.
shawn (sre): monitoring, no spike in 5xx after revert canary at 5%. metrics look stable.
emma (oncall): ramping to 50% over 15m as long as metrics hold.
lee (deploy): ramp complete, now 100% on v4.0.9 for eu-1.
shawn (sre): final check: 5xx 0.12%, latency nominal.
emma (oncall): marking incident resolved. follow-up postmortem scheduled. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
priya (eng): attaching root-cause details and repro steps to INC-2026-1734 for postmortem.
maria (customer-success): updated customers with resolution note and apology.
emma (oncall): closing thread. if any new anomalies appear reopen.
